graduated_modules.verification: All 10 bring-up components have a live _stubs/<name>.py byte-identical to _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native and a native_probe.json (ttnn dispatch > 0). No .last_good_sharded exists (TP=1, parallelism_manifest chips=1). bringup_status statuses: NEW=decoder_layer; ADAPT=token_embed, attention, layer, encoder_stack, decoder_head; REUSE=mlp, m_l_p, r_m_s_norm, rotary_embedding. The four REUSE entries nonetheless carry graduated native stubs + last_good_native snapshots, so they are graduated work products here and are routed too; none is left out.

list.name: token_embed
list.role: token ids -> hidden [B,S,2048] (prefill and every decode step)

list.name: rotary_embedding
list.role: on-device cos/sin from device position ids, every prefill and decode step, fed to every attention

list.name: encoder_stack
list.role: THE repeated-block container: holds the 42 decoder layers as one same-typed list and chains them (its __call__ is the layer loop)

list.name: decoder_layer
list.role: pre-norm residual block body for even layers

list.name: layer
list.role: pre-norm residual block body for odd layers (same class, so the stack stays same-typed)

list.name: attention
list.role: GQA self-attention inside every layer, writes/reads the device-resident KV cache

list.name: r_m_s_norm
list.role: every RMSNorm: 2 per layer + the final norm

task_heads.input: tokenizer.apply_chat_template(published example, verbatim) -> input_ids [1,20], tiled to B=32 identical rows
task_heads.reference: HF LlamaForCausalLM (fp32 weights from the bf16 checkpoint) model.generate(): generation_config's sampling chain (top_k 50 -> top_p 0.95, temperature 1.0) realised as Gumbel-max with per-sample seeded noise (seed = BASE_SEED + i), eos [1,130073], max_new_tokens 128 from the example
chain: prefill: ids[B,Sp] -> token_embed -> rotary_embedding(pos) -> encoder_stack[42 x (decoder_layer|layer){r_m_s_norm, attention(+KV write), r_m_s_norm, mlp|m_l_p}] -> slice last real token -> r_m_s_norm(final) -> decoder_head -> on-device top-k/top-p/Gumbel argmax -> token
decode (per token): token -> token_embed -> rotary_embedding(pos) -> encoder_stack (KV read+write at pos) -> r_m_s_norm -> decoder_head -> on-device sampler -> token; pos += 1 on device
task_heads.pass_definition: Gate 1 every routed stub is ttnn (no torch compute in hot path); Gate 2 every one of the 10 graduated stubs is invoked inside the real forward (invocation counters, > 0 each, counts consistent with 42 layers); Gate 3 e2e logits PCC >= 0.99 on every one of the 32 rows over the WHOLE generated output, prefill hidden state PCC >= 0.995 (min over rows) and |tt|/|ref| within 0.5%, generated tokens equal the HF reference under the same stop rule
task_heads.validation_metric: e2e PCC = min over 32 rows of PCC(TT step logits over all generated steps, HF logits at the same positions); printed as `e2e PCC=<x>` every run
task_heads.behavioral_proof: decoded text of each row is the model's thinking-mode self introduction; 32 rows differ (distinct seeds) and each matches its own HF golden row
task_heads.decode_horizon: model stop rule: eos_token_id [1,130073] OR the published example's max_new_tokens=128, applied identically to TT and HF; safety cap = max_position_embeddings - prompt_len (asserted not reached)
task_heads.batch: B=32 from $TT_PERF_BATCH; content identical, seeds BASE_SEED+i
self_validation: re-run tests/pcc for every edited stub (B=1 API kept)

trace_contract.prefill: pin S to capacity Sp (prompt rounded to tile) in persistent ids/pos/mask buffers; items = B x Sp
trace_contract.decode: persistent token/pos/noise buffers; KV caches [B,2,C,128] per layer resident; items = B; repeats = max_new_tokens (128)
